d: Distribution and habitat. " Lacustricola " johnstoni is a widespread species occurring in the Lower, Middle and Upper Zambezi River, including the Shire River and Lake Malawi, the Limpopo River, and is also present in the Okavango system (Fig. 2). The species is usually found associated with marginal vegetation along the banks of small and large rivers, or in swampy areas, as well as along the shores of Lake Malawi and Lake Kariba.
